titleEn: Poly-B Pipe Replacement in Vancouver & Metro Vancouver: 2026 Costs, Risks & What Homeowners Need to Know
titleZh: 温哥华及大温地区聚丁烯（Poly-B）管道更换完整指南（2026年版）
contentEn:
Vancouver-area homeowners with homes built between 1986 and 1997 face a hidden threat: Poly-B piping. Grey in colour with dull fitting connections, polybutylene (Poly-B) was installed in an estimated 60,000 Metro Vancouver homes before being discontinued due to failure rates linked to chlorine reactions in municipal water supplies.

How to Identify Poly-B Pipes

Poly-B pipes are grey plastic tubing 12–25 mm in diameter with dull white or grey crimp or insert fittings. They typically run through basements, crawlspaces, and inside walls. A plumber can confirm within 30 minutes.

What Happens When Poly-B Fails

Poly-B fails as slow micro-fracture leaks or sudden burst failures releasing thousands of litres of water. BC insurers have classified Poly-B as high-risk since the early 2000s; many refuse new policies on affected homes. A single water-loss claim can exceed $75,000 in structural remediation.

2026 Replacement Cost in Vancouver and Metro Vancouver

Re-plumbing an average Vancouver single-family home with copper costs $8,000–$18,000 depending on fixtures and layout complexity. Repiping a townhouse or condo runs $4,000–$9,000. Surrey, Richmond, and Coquitlam homes fall within these ranges.

Does Home Insurance Cover Poly-B Replacement?

Most BC insurers no longer cover homes with documented Poly-B. Some specialty insurers offer coverage with an inspection condition. Proactive replacement eliminates the insurance risk and can reduce monthly premiums by $50–$150/month.

Why Choose Repiping Over Patch Repairs

Every patch repair leaves other weak sections in place. Full re-piping with a 25-year labour warranty eliminates recurrence risk and is typically required before an insurer will cover a home with documented Poly-B.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does Poly-B replacement take?

Average single-family home: 5–8 working days from start to pressure test.

Does Surrey require a permit for re-piping?

Yes. A plumbing permit and inspection are required. Reno Stars handles permit applications for Surrey, Richmond, and Coquitlam.

Can I sell my home with Poly-B pipes?

You can, but buyer home inspectors typically flag Poly-B and lenders may require replacement as a financing condition. Disclosing known Poly-B issues is legally required in BC.
contentZh:
温哥华地区1986年至1997年间建成的房屋面临隐性威胁：聚丁烯（Poly-B）管道。大温地区约60,000套住宅安装了这种灰色塑料管道，后因与市政供水氯气反应导致的故障率而被停用。

如何识别Poly-B管道

Poly-B管道为灰色塑料管，直径12至25毫米，接头为暗白色或灰色压接或插入式连接，通常分布在地下室、爬行空间和墙内。专业水管工可在30分钟内确认您家中是否存在该管道。

Poly-B管道故障的后果

Poly-B管道故障表现为隐形微裂缝渗漏或突然爆裂，可能在数小时内释放数千升水。BC省保险公司自2000年代初即将Poly-B列为高风险状况，许多公司拒绝为有记录Poly-B的房屋承保新保单。

2026年温哥华及大温地区更换费用

铜管重装：独立屋平均费用8,000至18,000加元，视固定装置和布局复杂度而定；联排别墅或公寓4,000至9,000加元。素里、列治文和高贵林住宅费用相近。

房屋保险是否覆盖Poly-B更换？

大多数BC省保险公司不再为有记录Poly-B的房屋提供保险，部分专业保险公司可附加检验条件后承保。主动更换可消除保险风险，月保费通常可节省50至150加元。

为何选择全面重装而非局部修补

每次局部修补都留下其他薄弱环节。全面重装并附25年人工保修可消除复发风险，也是保险公司为有记录Poly-B房屋承保的通常条件。

常见问题

Poly-B更换需要多长时间？

独立屋平均5至8个工作日，从开工到压力测试完成。

素里是否需要管道重装许可证？

是的，需要管道许可证和检验。聚星装修代办素里、列治文和高贵林的许可证申请。

房屋有Poly-B管道可以出售吗？

可以出售，但买家验房师通常会标记Poly-B问题，贷款机构可能要求以此作为贷款条件。在BC省，已知Poly-B问题必须披露。
